description:
[Trading Data API] Latest crypto headlines aggregated from Cointelegraph, Decrypt and Bitcoin Magazine, newest first: title, source, URL, published time and a short summary. Filter by keyword or source.

**Example:** `/v1/crypto-news?q=etf&limit=10`

Use when you want the latest crypto headlines from major outlets, newest first. Not for market data.

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

q.description: Optional. Keyword filter on title and summary.

source.description: Optional. cointelegraph, decrypt or bitcoinmagazine (default all).

name: crypto_news
